The '''Balaidas system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Balaidas Academy]].<ref name="A Certain Point of View">{{JournalCite|8|A Certain Point of View (short story)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Balaidas system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-8.<ref name="TEA" />
